detailed_descriptions.en: Step into a museum where hundreds of collectible waifu figures have been scattered across the halls. Your job is to restore the collection, one model at a time. Pick up each figure, inspect its details, and use the museum guide to discover where it belongs. Sort models by theme, scale, and collection , then carefully place them back on display. From sporty fitness girls to gothic beauties and dazzling idols, each hall features its own unique collection to restore. As you work, turn messy floors and chaotic rooms into beautiful, perfectly organized exhibitions. Features Restore a chaotic waifu museum — Find scattered models and return them to their rightful displays. 420 Collectible Figures & Over 3,600 Pieces — Discover, sort, and organize an enormous collection of waifu figures and scattered pieces. Collect and organize — Identify each figure by its theme, scale, and model information. Multiple themed halls — Explore collections such as Sports, Gothic, Idol, and more. Build the perfect exhibition — Watch each hall transform from chaos into a carefully curated collection. Relaxing, satisfying gameplay — Pick up, sort, place, and admire your growing museum. Life-Size 1:1 Models — Discover impressive full-scale waifu figures designed to stand out as the centerpiece of the museum. A Variety of Materials — Find models made from different materials, including plastic, metal, silver, gold, glass, and more. Can you restore the entire collection and become the ultimate Waifu Curator?

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Step into a museum where hundreds of collectible waifu figures have been scattered across the halls. Your job is to restore the collection, one model at a time.

Pick up each figure, inspect its details, and use the museum guide to discover where it belongs. Sort models by theme, scale, and collection, then carefully place them back on display.

From sporty fitness girls to gothic beauties and dazzling idols, each hall features its own unique collection to restore.

As you work, turn messy floors and chaotic rooms into beautiful, perfectly organized exhibitions.

Features

  • Restore a chaotic waifu museum — Find scattered models and return them to their rightful displays.

  • 420 Collectible Figures & Over 3,600 Pieces — Discover, sort, and organize an enormous collection of waifu figures and scattered pieces.

  • Collect and organize — Identify each figure by its theme, scale, and model information.

  • Multiple themed halls — Explore collections such as Sports, Gothic, Idol, and more.

  • Build the perfect exhibition — Watch each hall transform from chaos into a carefully curated collection.

  • Relaxing, satisfying gameplay — Pick up, sort, place, and admire your growing museum.

  • Life-Size 1:1 Models — Discover impressive full-scale waifu figures designed to stand out as the centerpiece of the museum.

  • A Variety of Materials — Find models made from different materials, including plastic, metal, silver, gold, glass, and more.

Can you restore the entire collection and become the ultimate Waifu Curator?
